mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 2 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the combined effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE changes on 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (YoY change < 2%), it signals strong demand without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the combined effect of RSAFS and CPIAUCSL changes on 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the combined effect of INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases on 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
